title: host.asset (platform → host)
description: Reads one map or skin picture from the host's CS2 install and uploads it with PUT <platform>/api/fleet/host/assets/<this message's id> (Authorization: Bearer the host token; body: the PNG, JPEG or SVG), then answers. Sets: maps-1280 and maps-480 (map screenshots, JPEG), map-icons (<map>_icon.svg), skins-256 and skins (skin previews, PNG; _medium and _heavy are the worn looks). Hosts that can do this list assets.v1 in hello. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id): ok after the upload, not_found when the install has no such picture. Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
